mapper.sql: id, embedding_config_id, doc_ref_type, doc_ref_id, chunk_index, chunk_text, embedding::text AS embedding_text, source_type, source_url, title, source_org, published_at, degree, college, campus, grade_range, meta::text AS meta_json, created_at
mapper.select: WITH filtered AS ( SELECT ec.id, ec.embedding_config_id, ec.doc_ref_type, ec.doc_ref_id, ec.chunk_index, ec.chunk_text, ec.embedding::text AS embedding_text, ec.source_type, ec.source_url, ec.title, ec.source_org, ec.published_at, ec.degree, ec.college, ec.campus, ec.grade_range, CASE WHEN ec.source_type = 'UGC' THEN ec.meta || jsonb_build_object( 'likes', approved_ugc.likes, 'reports', approved_ugc.reports ) ELSE ec.meta END AS meta, ec.created_at, official_document.reference_type AS document_reference_type, official_document.id AS document_id, official_document.external_source_url AS external_source_url, ec.embedding <=> CAST(#{queryEmbedding} AS vector) AS distance FROM embedding_chunk ec LEFT JOIN document official_document ON ec.source_type = 'OFFICIAL' AND ec.doc_ref_type = 'DOCUMENT' AND official_document.id = ec.doc_ref_id LEFT JOIN ugc_post approved_ugc ON ec.source_type = 'UGC' AND ec.doc_ref_type = 'UGC' AND approved_ugc.id = ec.doc_ref_id AND approved_ugc.status = 'APPROVED' WHERE ec.embedding_config_id = #{embeddingConfigId} AND (CAST(#{sourceType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS varchar) IS NULL OR ec.source_type = #{sourceType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND (CAST(#{degree,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS varchar) IS NULL OR ec.degree = #{degree,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR ec.degree = 'GENERAL') AND (CAST(#{college,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS varchar) IS NULL OR ec.college = #{college,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR ec.college = 'GENERAL') AND (CAST(#{campus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS varchar) IS NULL OR ec.campus = #{campus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR ec.campus = 'GENERAL') AND (CAST(#{gradeRange,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS varchar) IS NULL OR ec.grade_range = #{gradeRange,jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR ec.grade_range = 'GENERAL') AND ( ( ec.source_type = 'OFFICIAL' AND official_document.id IS NOT NULL ) OR ( ec.source_type = 'UGC' AND approved_ugc.id IS NOT NULL ) ) ) SELECT id, embedding_config_id, doc_ref_type, doc_ref_id, chunk_index, chunk_text, embedding_text, source_type, source_url, title, source_org, published_at, degree, college, campus, grade_range, meta::text AS meta_json, created_at, document_reference_type, document_id, external_source_url, 1.0 - distance AS score FROM filtered ORDER BY distance ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{topK}

INSERT INTO embedding_chunk ( embedding_config_id, doc_ref_type, doc_ref_id, chunk_index, chunk_text, embedding, source_type, source_url, title, source_org, published_at, degree, college, campus, grade_range, meta ) VALUES
( #{chunk.embeddingConfigId}, #{chunk.docRefType}, #{chunk.docRefId}, #{chunk.chunkIndex}, #{chunk.chunkText}, CAST(#{chunk.embeddingText} AS vector), #{chunk.sourceType}, #{chunk.sourceUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{chunk.title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{chunk.sourceOrg,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{chunk.publishedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{chunk.degree,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{chunk.college,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{chunk.campus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{chunk.gradeRange,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(#{chunk.metaJson} AS jsonb) )
RETURNING
